name: deep-read-web
description: Read the full HTML of public or manually authenticated web pages with Playwright.

interface.shortDescription: Read page HTML from public and login-protected pages
interface.longDescription: Deep Read Web lets Codex open a target page, detect when manual login is required, wait for authentication in a visible browser window, and return the final page HTML for downstream analysis.
defaultPrompt: Read the HTML of this protected web page and wait for me to log in if needed.
